title: Smoothing a Path Without Cutting Corners: Pulling Points Straight, Holding Them Near the Plan, and Not Into the Wall

artifact.note: smoothing a path: even resampling, then a gradient smoother that moves each interior point towards its neighbours' midpoint and back towards where the plan had it, with the ends fixed, refusing any move into a cell of the cost grid that is inscribed or worse; the curvature of three points (Menger) measures the result
